2609.06226.title: Scratchy: Visual-Scratchpad Multimodal Reasoning for Cryptographic Proof Generation in EasyCrypt
2609.06226.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently made substantial progress in formal proof generation, yet presenting distinctive challenges in cryptographic area. Computational security arguments posit that a valid proof must coordinate probability, adversarial games, invariants, assumptions and bounds, which can be provided by a machine-checked framework named EasyCrypt. Although all objects may appear in available context, LLMs still struggle because proof-theoretic dependencies are typically implicit in a linear representation and distributed across multiple programs. So, this paper presents Scratchy, a visual-scratchpad approach that exposes these dependencies for multimodal generation. Given the natural-language security description, with formal context and target propositions, the proof objects can be normalized into a typed proof-relation graph. Then a structure-preserving visual compiler transforms the graph into the formula-rich visual proof state that guides a multimodal model in generating the EasyCrypt proof. Also, the Scratchy-eval, a 114-task dataset derived from reliable official EasyCrypt files, has been introduced. It contains 64 security-form proof generations and 50 multiple-choice knowledge tests. After a series of evaluations, covering semantic grounding, relational invariants, and game reductions, classical LLMs like GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 have gained a clear advantage from Scratchy's structured visual proof states. This contrast suggests that explicit proof structure can make the improvement and multimodal proof-state representation as a promising direction for computer-aided cryptography.
2609.06226.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）最近在形式證明生成方面取得了重大進展，但在密碼學領域仍面臨獨特的挑戰。計算安全論證認為，有效的證明必須協調概率、對抗性遊戲、不變性、假設和界限，這些可以通過一個名為 EasyCrypt 的機器檢查框架來提供。儘管所有對象可能出現在可用的上下文中，LLMs 仍然面臨困難，因為證明理論依賴性通常在線性表示中是隱含的，並且分佈在多個程序中。因此，本文提出了 Scratchy，一種可視化草稿板方法，揭示了這些依賴性以進行多模態生成。給定自然語言的安全描述，連同正式上下文和目標命題，證明對象可以被標準化為一個類型化的證明關係圖。然後，一個保持結構的可視化編譯器將圖轉換為公式豐富的可視化證明狀態，指導多模態模型生成 EasyCrypt 證明。此外，Scratchy-eval 是一個從可靠的官方 EasyCrypt 文件中衍生的 114 任務數據集，已被引入。它包含 64 個安全形式的證明生成和 50 個多選知識測試。在一系列評估之後，涵蓋語義基礎、關係不變性和遊戲簡化，像 GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-5 這樣的經典 LLMs 從 Scratchy 的結構化可視化證明狀態中獲得了明顯的優勢。這一對比表明，明確的證明結構可以促進改進，而多模態證明狀態表示是一個有前景的計算機輔助密碼學方向。
